decision: The merged per-bundle offerPermissions list splits by bundle: Offer read is read from the Offer Preparer or the Offer Approver; prepare, transmission and estimate/model preparation from the Preparer; approve and response from the Approver
why: The API builds offerPermissions as the union of both bundles (company-context-authorization.ts), and every other Offer permission belongs to exactly one bundle

decision: Literal fixtures take the registry grant of their captured version (or the lowest covering version, with a synthetic assignment id when none was captured); helper fixtures that vary the merged Offer list per test build it through offerGrants, which narrows a grant by hand only when the list is narrower than every registry version
why: Keeps every component assertion that checks one Offer permission on its own (read-only, approve-only); the current Actor parser refuses a narrowed grant (#1332), so mocked browser specs never serve one

decision: Profitability per-bundle fields are dropped from the fixtures; Offer, Commercial Intake and Client per-bundle fields stay beside the grants
why: No source reads the Profitability fields any more; unmigrated screens (Contract, Commercial Intake, Commercial PDF, Client) still read the others

decision: An unknown captured version (Offer Approver future, Profitability Director future, Contributor v999) or a permission its version does not confer becomes a readCurrentActor refusal of the whole Actor; the no-grant case keeps the feature-only denial
why: The current Actor parser refuses such a grant for the whole Actor (#1332), as #1381, #1383 and #1384 did
